## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(2)` | `2` |   | RTCP version (2). |
| `padding` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | P bit: padding octets at the end of the packet (Manual). |
| `source_count` | `uint(5)` |   | Number of items of `chunks` | Source count: SDES chunks or BYE identifiers (Auto). |
| `packet_type` | `enum(8)` | `202` (sdes) |   | Packet type (200 SR, 201 RR, 202 SDES, 203 BYE, 204 APP, 205 RTPFB, 206 PSFB, 207 XR). |
| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header in 32-bit words (`-1`) | Packet length in 32-bit words minus one (Auto). |
| `chunks` | `list<struct>` — `source_count` items | 1 items |   | SDES chunks: SSRC / CSRC and its items (type, length (Auto), text), ended by a null octet and padded to 32 bits. |
